notes.title: BloodRayne Terminal Cut Editions Receive Fan Requested Update
notes.content:
[b][h1]BloodRayne fans rejoice! [/h1][/b]
Ziggurat is thrilled to announce that we have a new update to both Terminal Cut editions of BloodRayne.

By popular demand, both games now use XInput style button prompts in game while playing with a gamepad, replacing the original generic text button prompts.


[b]Other updates include:[/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/0e57364a903c8f532ac01b76dd2e20ebe3d52cfb.png[/img]

[h1]BloodRayne: Terminal Cut[/h1]
[list]
[*] Two missing 'uncensored' textures restored that were previously missing
[*] Culling of reflections/fog improved to prevent unintended drop out at the edge of the screen at certain view distances.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373510

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/42c406fd6791d3f3bf760554e657a061bcc09d00.png[/img]

[h1]BloodRayne 2: Terminal Cut[/h1]
[list]
[*] Restored a cutscene of Ephemera confronting Rayne which did not play during the game in previous versions.
[*] Fixed a bug where a line of dialog spoken by Severin would cause Rayne's mouth to move 
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373550

notes.title: Rayne is Back in a Blood Drenched Remaster
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/_JyzjRQZ3Us][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/da287ca8622df960bcce64d43c0b012fe4158fe0.jpg[/img][/url]

We are thrilled to announce the remastered, high definition edition of BloodRayne Betrayal: Fresh Bites is coming this summer to PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One X|S, Xbox Series X|S and (for the first time) Nintendo Switch.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/dbc91db05a2f3da1e610d783858f101902896eb2.gif[/img]

In development by WayForward, the game’s original creators, this updated version of the hit 2D hack ‘n’ slash platformer will feature all-new voice acting performed by the original BloodRayne cast — featuring Laura Bailey (Rayne) and Troy Baker (Kagan).

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/e2416acdf1e4f777272b42c5c9a088275db8ebe0.gif[/img]

Do you prefer to get physical? We have partnered with Limited Run Games to offer an exclusive, multiplatform physical release for PlayStation 4 & 5 and Nintendo Switch later this year.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/0fa0290327a725da36c6ddd0b3651404bfeb4955.gif[/img]

[h1]Wishlist today!
[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550260

notes.title: BloodRayne Receives Final Update Today
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/3c83ee78aeae30f0078bb3d6b89270178e43d688.jpg[/img]

Last year we brought Rayne out of the 2000s and into the modern era with the release of Terminal Cut editions of BloodRayne and BloodRayne 2. These editions introduced an enhanced lighting system, improved environment effects, increased resolution and improved rendering among many other improvements. 

Today we are launching a new patch for both Terminal Cut games which we anticipate to be the last significant update for these games. The Ultimate Update includes balance changes, localization improvements and feature upgrades that build upon the impressive Terminal Cut enhancements players already enjoy. 

Now is the perfect time to relive Rayne’s first two adventures, or complete your collection, all three BloodRayne games are 40% off, our lowest price ever! 

[url=https://youtu.be/40nttfrsfFI][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/47b95339cff642130c7fc1873337bbcb30c06cc3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]BloodRayne: Terminal Cut Ultimate Update[/h1]
Rayne’s debut game has gotten even better. This patch includes many updates that fans have been asking for such as mutants with their proper flesh color! 

[b]Update Features
[/b]
[list]
[*] Textures on enemy models have been restored to their original console version aesthetic
[*] Japanese voice-acting and subtitles have been added
[*] Additional rendering improvements to water and other textures
[*] Miscellaneous bug fixes
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373510

[url=https://youtu.be/BZ9G24q_904][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/9ebe87a3a17926bbe6fc1ca3afb6da1e3ce226c6.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]BloodRayne 2: Terminal Cut Ultimate Update[/h1]
Rayne returns to her updated second adventure. In addition to language and sound improvements, this patch introduces a rebalanced boss fight with Ephemera in the Twisted Garden to better match the experience players remember from the console version.

[b]Update Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Ephemera boss fight rebalanced
[*] Restoration of missing music and audio tracks
[*] Improved graphical fidelity for bonus materials
[*] Russian language localization improvements
[*] Miscellaneous bug fixes
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373550

notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just to recap the last week or so we have set 2 updates live since launch, the first to cover an issue with starting the game and just recently an update to address language settings in the game.  The game will now pull the appropriate language from your Steam settings.

Both updates are live, if you are continuing to experience problems with your game starting or other issues, please continue to post in the discussions section.  We have a pinned discussion thread to go over more serious game issues, appropriately titled "Game Issues" that we will continue to review posts in but we are listening to any and all feedback.

Thank you all for your support, it's been great bringing Rayne back to the Steam Community!

- Midnight City
